{{MoreSources}}
[[File:Space_station_SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A space station]]
{{Quote|That's no moon. It's a space station.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], scrutinizing the first Death Star|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>|audio=ThatsNoMoon-ANH.flac}}
'''Space stations''' were artificial structures built for use in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] or deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The term was also used by one standard [[Starship/Legends|ship]] classification system to classify some of the largest and most heavily armed [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==History==
While some space stations were civilian installations designed for habitation or research (such as [[Citadel Station]] making up the infrastructure backbone of the [[Telosian Restoration Project]]), or as orbiting space docks, a great many were well-armed military installations generally used in a defensible position. The most famous military space stations were the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] and [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Unlike most space stations, they were mobile and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable, thus making them match the definition of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] as well.
